body.statement: As a corollary of the projection-and-lift theorem, let \(N=\lvert\mathcal H\rvert\), \(A_\Sigma=\sum_{h\in\mathcal H}\lvert\mathcal A(h)\rvert\), and \(E=\sum_{h,a}\lvert\operatorname{ch}(h,a)\rvert\). The formulation \(\mathcal R(P)\) has \(O\{K(N+A_\Sigma)\}\) variables and constraints and \(O\{K(N+A_\Sigma+E)\}\) nonzero coefficients, all affine in observed multinomial probabilities. Membership of \(q\) and \(\sigma_P(c)\) have exact primal and strong-dual certificates, and any feasible solution yields a recursive attaining sampler.
body.justification: The tree-sized fixed matrix makes full-law sharpness computationally usable once exact causal projection is established.
body.gap: Russell2021 permits generic random-set and transport programs, GreseleEtAl2022 permits full response-function projection, and Ponomarev2024 minimizes the Artstein collection for a generic set-valued-prediction correspondence. None combines the maximum-specific local system with intervention reach and tree laminarity to obtain this dimension bound.
body.consumer: A trial analyst can compute exact feasibility, quantile bounds, tail probabilities, or any linear oracle-law support value without enumerating exponentially many global response types.
